searchForUpcomingAppointments() - Method in class controller.LoginController
Method that performs the searching of the upcoming appointments within the next 15 minutes Two Lambda Expressions First Lambda Expression that will run through each row of the appointments table and Check the Month and Day to see if it matches the current date and will put it in an ObservableMap Second Lambda Expression will Check the appointments in the ObservableMap and find the nearest appointment within 15 minutes and append it to the StringBuilder
